scope: Two official UN items, original bodies captured before parsing. Historical/current public administration evidence only; no outcome judgment.

facts.fact: PGA Khalilur Rahman met Cuban Foreign Minister Bruno Rodríguez Parrilla; they discussed Cuba’s expectations for the 81st session and exchanged views on Cuba’s humanitarian situation and the coming embargo debate. Documents a serving foreign minister conducting official diplomacy; does not document internal territorial control or a political transfer.

facts.source: UN in Cuba country-office story after UN Special Representative Kamal Kishore’s visit
facts.fact: The UN describes Cuba’s disaster-risk system as linking scientific institutions, Civil Defense, provincial and municipal governments; early-warning coordination joins meteorology, water resources and Civil Defense, while communities have local response mechanisms. It also identifies an ongoing need to move from preparedness to risk reduction and embed risk planning in housing, water, energy, education and essential services.

limit: This is contemporaneous evidence of functioning state-linked administrative coordination across national/provincial/local levels, reported by the UN. It is not direct verification that PCC exercises de facto governing control over a majority of the population, nor evidence about armed-force/elite cohesion, coercive orders or opposition territorial reach. Those remain unverified.
